name: NIKE, Inc.
research_rationale: Channel commentary points to softer Nike and Jordan demand without new filings; the Aug-2026 10-Q revenue decline and thin Q1 cash flow still weaken, not confirm, the screen buy.

weekly_updates.summary:
Aug-2026 10-Q (filed Oct) shows revenues down 4% and Q1 operating cash flow of $135m, with Greater China and marketplace-reset actions still pressuring results.
17 Nov Investor Day 8-K outlines Full Stride Ahead and 2031 targets; subsequent news highlights share weakness and sceptical near-term reset commentary.
Q2 FY27 results are scheduled for 17 Dec; outcomes are not yet in the supplied file set.

Since the 18:20 refresh, the batch is thin and includes no new company filings.
Headlines note ~$247.4m of Nike stock in the company 401(k) at 31 May 2026 and channel pieces on softer Nike sportswear and Jordan demand ahead of Dick's Q3.
Q2 FY27 on 17 Dec remains outside the supplied file set.
